build_kv_connector: build an ExampleConnector KV cache connector that saves and loads KV cache to disk
build_connector_metadata: build ExampleConnectorMetadata with request token IDs, block IDs, and store/load flags
start_load_kv_cache: start loading KV cache from disk into vLLM's paged KV buffer via start_load_kv
save_kv_cache_layer: save a KV cache layer from vLLM's paged buffer to disk as safetensors
check_cache_hit: check if a request has a KV cache hit using get_num_new_matched_tokens
